models: Fender Stratocaster (B.C. Rich, Gibson Explorer used early)

tone.target: fuzzy alt-rock power-chord crunch with bright upper mids
tone.profile: fuzzy alt-rock power-chord crunch with bright upper mids
tone.summary: A fuzz/OD blend into a UK 45 amp model, paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cab. Compression ensures tight attack for power chords, while EQ boosts upper mids for that signature Weezer brightness.
corrections: favor fuzzier breakup over pop-punk crunch

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise from aggressive fuzz/distortion.
Provide initial grit and breakup for the fuzzy alt-rock tone.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used as a general dirt source, approximating the required fuzz/OD blend before the main distortion stage.

blocks.purpose: Deliver the core fuzzy grit and aggressive saturation required for the riffs.
Tighten the power-chord attack and maintain consistent volume.
Simulate the Marshall-style amp and provide bright upper mids.
Provide the classic Marshall-style cabinet sound.
Enhance the bright upper mids and slightly reduce low end as requested.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the default IR for a more genre-appropriate, aggressive 4x12.

proposals.reason: Enhance aggression and grit of the alt-rock tone.
